_notes: WiseCases case template. Replace every value that starts with TEMPLATE: with your own content.
Required: id, title, category, difficulty, status, startingLives, startingScore, at least one stage (stageNumber, title, clue), and diagnosis (primary + at least one accepted answer).
Everything else is optional. Leave out what you do not have: WiseCases never fills in missing medical content.
Stages: use as many as the case needs (3, 5, 7, 10 ...). Number them 1, 2, 3 ... without gaps.
decisionPoint is optional. Without it, the stage asks 'What is the most likely diagnosis?' and its answer options are built from your diagnosis and differential diagnoses.
A correct answer at any stage ends the case, so the correct option should be the diagnosis.
Imported cases always start as drafts. Only a super administrator can publish.
Fields named _notes are ignored on import.
